user_message: What did the 2015 direct detection of gravitational waves actually measure, and how did interferometers infer an astrophysical collision from it?
allowed_evidence: In 2015, LIGO observed a tiny, time-varying differential change in two perpendicular arm lengths. General-relativistic waveform models connect such strain patterns to compact-binary motion. This result postdates 1988.
public_rubric: Identifies the measured quantity rather than saying the detector photographed black holes.
Connects the changing signal pattern to model-based source inference.
Separates direct measurement from astrophysical interpretation.
